cat > build3.py << 'EOF'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, RWMol
from rdkit.Chem.rdchem import BondType, ChiralType

f1 = Chem.MolFromSmiles("[C@H]1(Nc2ccccc2)/C=C/C=C/CC1")
f2 = Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC1(C)c2cccc(P(c3ccccc3)c4ccccc4)c2Oc2c1cccc2P(c5ccccc5)c6ccccc6")

def build(stereo_smiles_f1):
    f1 = Chem.MolFromSmiles(stereo_smiles_f1)
    rw = RWMol()
    map1 = {a.GetIdx(): rw.AddAtom(a) for a in f1.GetAtoms()}
    for b in f1.GetBonds():
        rw.AddBond(map1[b.GetBeginAtomIdx()], map1[b.GetEndAtomIdx()], b.GetBondType())
    map2 = {a.GetIdx(): rw.AddAtom(a) for a in f2.GetAtoms()}
    for b in f2.GetBonds():
        rw.AddBond(map2[b.GetBeginAtomIdx()], map2[b.GetEndAtomIdx()], b.GetBondType())
    pd_idx = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(46))
    p_idxs = [map2[i] for i in range(f2.GetNumAtoms()) if f2.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="P"]
    for pi in p_idxs:
        rw.AddBond(pi, pd_idx, BondType.DATIVE)
    for ci in (map1[2], map1[3]):   # the Pd-bound alkene carbons (B and A)
        rw.AddBond(ci, pd_idx, BondType.DATIVE)
    mol = rw.GetMol()
    Chem.SanitizeMol(mol)
    from rdkit.Chem import rdCIPLabeler
    rdCIPLabeler.AssignCIPLabels(mol)
    lab = None
    for a in mol.GetAtoms():
        if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'):
            lab = (a.GetIdx(), a.GetProp('_CIPCode'))
    return mol, lab

for smi in ("[C@H]1(Nc2ccccc2)/C=C/C=C/CC1", "[C@@H]1(Nc2ccccc2)/C=C/C=C/CC1"):
    mol, lab = build(smi)
    print(smi, "->", lab, Chem.MolToSmiles(mol))
EOF

    f1 = Chem.MolFromSmiles(f1_smi)
    f2 = Chem.MolFromSmiles("CC1(C)c2cccc(P(c3ccccc3)c4ccccc4)c2Oc2c1cccc2P(c5ccccc5)c6ccccc6")
    rw = RWMol()
    map1 = {a.GetIdx(): rw.AddAtom(a) for a in f1.GetAtoms()}
    for b in f1.GetBonds(): rw.AddBond(map1[b.GetBeginAtomIdx()], map1[b.GetEndAtomIdx()], b.GetBondType())
    map2 = {a.GetIdx(): rw.AddAtom(a) for a in f2.GetAtoms()}

    pd = rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(46))
    for pi in [map2[i] for i in range(f2.GetNumAtoms()) if f2.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()=="P"]:

    for ci in (map1[8], map1[9]):

bonds=defaultdict(list)
def dist(i,j): return np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j])
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1,n):
        d=dist(i,j)
        cut={'H':1.3,'C':1.9,'N':1.8,'O':1.8,'P':2.0,'Pd':2.5}

            bonds[i].append(j); bonds[j].append(i)
nb=bonds[0]
